@Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler that would run it every Monday at 08:00 is unreachable from here: it needs gateway credentials that aren't configured, so nothing is scheduled yet. I haven't posted anything either. I can set it up once someone with gateway access fixes that, or I can post a one-off digest by hand on request.

When it runs, I'll use company time (America/Chicago) for the 08:00, starting Monday 19 October. It will cover #coastal-team and #coastal-random, which have the same members (you, Kwame, Sofia), so nothing gets pulled into the wrong audience. It will leave out money terms and finance documents (rates, prices, contract values, invoices). Those can only go to Anselm, June and the account owner, so the digest will point to them rather than quote them.
